notes.title: hotfix-Demo update June 10th
notes.content: [p]Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions! The new version includes several bug fixes as outlined below:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where key bindings were not saved after closing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when loading a save under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game UI would not display properly in some cases.[/p][/*][/list]
